text: Theo’s relentless drive to understand the cosmos stems from a deep-seated need to reconnect with his late mother, an astrophysicist who taught him that the universe is a place of wonder rather than emptiness. His nights on the rooftop were not merely observations but rituals of remembrance, where he sought answers in the celestial bodies she once studied. This emotional anchor explains his current actions, as he continues to look upward, searching for signs of her presence in the vastness above. Meanwhile, the rain that eventually falls from the fluffy things in the sky serves as a gentle reminder of the cycles of nature his mother loved, grounding his lofty aspirations in the tangible reality of the earth below.
